## Questions to answer

- What are the main approaches used in the literature?
- Which assumptions matter for the specific research problem?
- What numerical or modelling choices distinguish the approaches?
- What are the principal limitations or unresolved points?
- Which results or benchmarks should be reproduced or compared?
- Which existing SPECTRAL repositories or tools are relevant?
- What information is still missing before the research plan can be refined?

## Expected output

- [ ] Compact state-of-the-art map, not just a paper list
- [ ] Key references added to the research-activity `references.bib`
- [ ] Relevant assumptions and limitations documented
- [ ] Suitable benchmark/reference cases identified when applicable
- [ ] Existing reusable SPECTRAL assets identified when applicable
- [ ] Follow-up Research Questions and/or Issues proposed
- [ ] Proposed next-step decomposition reviewed with your Supervisor
